paidMediaSearch.method: Player-by-player search across Daily Telegraph and Sydney Morning Herald, using site search/search-engine queries and credentialed article review where a result appeared to contain salary, value, contract, or cap-space claims.
paidMediaSearch.promotionRule: Only direct article-reviewed money claims are promoted into source records. Search snippets and grouped roster buckets are retained as leads/context but not used as individual salary estimates.
paidMediaSearch.selected2026SalaryPolicy: The selected 2026 figure remains the Daily Telegraph roster-value investigation for players individually listed there. Historical contract AAVs and future retention reporting are stored as corroborating context unless they cleanly describe 2026 cap cost.
